evals.prompt: Turn this into a lightweight backlog story before design.md: We need a way for store associates to see why an online pickup order is blocked, because today they just get a generic failure and call support.
evals.expected_output: Markdown for a single backlog item with Type, Context, and Definition of Done. The response should ask for or infer a type, explain why the work matters and who cares, and use a user-story-appropriate DoD format if treated as a story.

evals.prompt: Write a spike for whether we should keep using our current feature flag service for experiments in checkout. We need enough for design.md, not a full plan.
evals.expected_output: Markdown with lightweight Context and a spike-specific Definition of Done organized into outputs and questions to answer.

evals.prompt: Create a bug ticket draft before design.md: on mobile Safari the checkout review button sometimes stays disabled after all required fields are complete.
evals.expected_output: Markdown with a bug Type, clear Context covering impact and audience, and a Definition of Done split into Observed Behavior and Expected Behavior.
